retrievalProfile.description: A split-composition layout featuring a warm-toned studio photograph above a high-contrast color-blocked typographic footer.
triggerTerms: split horizontal layout with color bar

recipe.visualDefinition: A two-part vertical composition where the top two-thirds features a warm, grainy photograph of a subject in a recording studio, and the bottom third consists of a black field with a blue horizontal bar containing ultra-condensed sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Top-heavy photographic subject balanced by a heavy typographic base
Yellow title text overlapping the photographic background for depth
Horizontal blue bar acting as a container for the primary subject name
Warm skin tones and yellow text contrasting against the cool blue and black footer
coreInvariants: Horizontal split at the lower third of the frame
Ultra-condensed sans-serif typeface for the primary name

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the upper right quadrant, leaning toward a microphone on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, light blue nameplate in the bottom third serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the yellow title (top left), move to the subject's face (top right), and drop to the large name (bottom).
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense composition with minimal negative space; the black footer provides the only significant rest area.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and medium blue in the footer
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for the secondary title text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow and blue elements against a grainy, mid-tone photograph.
paletteRestrictions: Must include a medium sky blue

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
Uniform stroke weight with minimal modulation
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' has very short horizontal curves to maintain the narrow profile
The 'O' is an elongated vertical oval
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Two weights/widths of the same condensed sans-serif family used in contrasting colors.

avoid: Centered title text at the top

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for the top title.
Clean, condensed sans-serif that matches the mid-century aesthetic.
Matches the ultra-narrow proportions of the bottom nameplate.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1960s-style studio photograph of a woman in a blue and white striped shirt smiling next to a vintage condenser microphone. The bottom third of the image should be a solid black field with a horizontal blue bar across its center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in an ultra-condensed light blue sans-serif font inside the blue bar. Add the secondary title in a bold condensed yellow sans-serif font in the top left corner, stacked in two lines.

verificationChecks: Is the top text yellow and stacked?
Is there a clear horizontal split in the composition?
Does the photograph have a warm, vintage grain?

mustRedesign: Do not use modern digital gradients
Do not use thin or light font weights
postGenerationChecks: Check that the blue bar is perfectly horizontal
Ensure the yellow text is legible against the photo
Verify the ultra-condensed font is not distorted
Confirm the split-screen ratio is approximately 2:1
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Photo (Top 2/3) + Yellow Condensed Title (Top Left) + Black Footer (Bottom 1/3) + Blue Bar with Ultra-Condensed Name.
